0022600198.text: The Minnesota Timberwolves (7-3) host the Utah Jazz (1-8) on a three-game winning streak, sitting 3rd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, and 6th in the West, while Utah has lost seven straight and is 5th in the Northwest, 6 games back, and 14th in the West. Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), and Terrence Shannon Jr. (out, hip bruise), and Joan Beringer is day-to-day with a fracture and a game-time decision, while Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (out, knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot strain). The teams have not played each other yet this season, and Timberwolves won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 147-111 win in Minneapolis on March 18, 2026.
